findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new TestLogger instance, discarding logged entries
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger() instead of returning the receiver f (or recording logs back to f). Because LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), calling FromContext on a TestLogger allocates a temporary TestLogger whose InfoLogs are mutated and immediately discarded, leaving the caller's TestLogger.InfoLogs empty (Calls == 0) and breaking unit tests that assert on TestLogger output (including logger_middleware_test.go).

findings.title: Missing nil-request guards in ContextualLoggerMiddleware and missing test coverage
findings.body: ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics dereference req.PluginContext without checking if req == nil. Because ContextualLoggerMiddleware is registered immediately before LoggerMiddleware (which explicitly guards if req == nil in all four methods), a nil request will panic in ContextualLoggerMiddleware before reaching LoggerMiddleware. In addition, no unit tests were added for ContextualLoggerMiddleware and logger_middleware_test.go was not updated to reflect moving pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, and dsUID out of LoggerMiddleware.
